subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally change Matrix polls above 20 options from accepted outbound input to an early validation error?
rationale: The limit matches MSC3381 and existing channel-cap patterns, but this remains a compatibility change because current Matrix callers are not locally rejected and server-side rejection was not demonstrated.

options.title: Adopt early rejection
options.body: Keep the patch, require real Matrix proof, and explicitly accept the clearer fail-before-send behavior rather than silently changing poll contents.

options.title: Preserve prior acceptance
options.body: Revise the Matrix path to retain existing caller behavior while defining how answers beyond the first 20 are handled.

recommendation.title: Adopt early rejection
recommendation.body: Keep the patch, require real Matrix proof, and explicitly accept the clearer fail-before-send behavior rather than silently changing poll contents.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest identified history match for the unified outbound poll-limit contract affected by the decision.
